## Sthenno (CR 20)

**XP** 307,200  
 LE Large outsider (evil, extraplanar, lawful)  
 **Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft.; Perception +27  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 38, touch 12, flat-footed 35 (+3 Dex, +26 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 225 (18d10+126); fast healing 5  
 **Fort** +13; **Ref** +16; **Will** +17  
 **DR** 15/epic and good; **Immune** paralysis, polymorph, sleep, stunning; **SR** 31  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 30 ft., fly 50 ft. (poor)  
 **Melee** 2 claws +28 (2d6+10 plus grab), bite +28 (1d10+10), snake bite +26 (1d8+5 plus poison)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** petrifying gaze, poison, rend (2 claws, 2d6+15)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 31, **Dex** 17, **Con** 24, **Int** 22, **Wis** 22, **Cha** 26  
 **Base Atk** +18; **CMB** +29 (+33 grapple); **CMD** 42 (can’t be tripped)  
 **Feats** Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (bite) Weapon Focus (claw), Weapon Focus (snake bite)  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +24, Bluff +29, Craft (alchemy) +27, Diplomacy +29, Fly +18, Intimidate +29, Knowledge (arcana) +27, Knowledge (planes) +27, Perception +27, Sense Motive +27, Stealth +20, Survival +24  
 **SQ** immortal  
 **Languages** Abyssal, Aklo, Common, Draconic, Infernal, Undercommon  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Immortal (Ex)** Euryale is immortal and cannot die from natural causes. She is not subject to death from massive damage and is immune to death effects and disintegration. She does not age, and does not need to sleep, eat, or breathe.  
 
 **Petrifying Gaze (Su)** *Turn to stone* permanently, 30 feet, Fortitude save (DC 27) negates. The save DC is Charisma-based.  
 
 **Poison (Ex)** Bite—injury; *save* Fort DC 26; *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* 1d6 Strength; *cure* 1 save.
